body: Went in with low expectations because of no big names, but the movie shocked me. Every department has done a neat job. Performances feel real especially hero villain clash scenes very well made, emotionally strong, and entertaining Madurai is shown in a fresh and authentic way One of the most satisfying commercial films this year.

The Ram fight is one of the highlights of the movie Not a familiar name but Dr Pragabhal surely will be a prominent director in kollywood coming years as his vision as a director comes through strongly in the way Ram figth sequence is executed like never before . Each detail is captured carefully, making the tradition sport powerful and realistic.

First off all Director deserves applause, as each scenes its very evident the amount of research was done to get this movie executed in such intensity wothout losing the freshness. Performances,camera work, stunts especially the goat figth scenes were really good. Surely this movie deserved to be a clean hit.

Jockey turned out to be one of those pleasant surprises that many viewers like me might have unfortunately missed in theatres Watching it now feels like discovering a hidden gem What makes the film stand out is its sincerity in storytelling, grounded narration,strong emotions and especially the characters which felt real.

Jockey stands out for its making quality. No star hype, yet the film delivers fully. Firstly the goat figth scenes felt fresh and very intense then Madurai's local culture and emotions are shown in such a way that after watching the movie surely madurai will be in our bucket lists to visit but also a reminder and that good cinema still works without big names.
